description: [Parkings GPS] Taux d'occupation des places monitorées - To dataWrapper is a dataset listed in Opendata de Grand Paris Sud open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by UPCITI. Les données de ces parkings sont remontées suite au déploiements de capteurs à la place de la société UPCITI qui en garantit l'exactitude. Coverage: Grand Paris Sud (Essonne and Seine-et-Marne). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are upciti, capteurs à la place. The portal shows 10 records. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Données sous licence gratuite de repartage. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-grandparissud-fr-portal.
